mnsdummy.config.no_catalog: Mine and Slash's stat list has not loaded.
mnsdummy.incompatible: Training Dummy is disabled: Mine and Slash %s has changed since this build of MnSDummy, which was made for %s. Check for an MnSDummy update. Nothing else in your game is affected.
mnsdummy.preset.naked.desc: No armour, no resists, no reduction, and no offence either. Measures your raw output, and makes its own return hit the bare number Mine and Slash gives a mob of that level.
mnsdummy.preset.common_mob.desc: Whatever Mine and Slash itself gives a common mob of your level.
mnsdummy.preset.map_boss.desc: The boss of a normal map. Sets the dummy to Mine and Slash's boss rarity and lets MnS build the stat block, so it is that mob, in this modpack, at your level.
mnsdummy.preset.uber_boss.desc: What an uber altar spawns. Uber tiers change the boss's level, not its stat block.
mnsdummy.preset.pinnacle_boss.desc: The pinnacle boss an uber map can roll instead. The tankiest thing the game spawns.
mnsdummy.preset.max_resist.desc: Resists at the 90%% cap, with nothing left over to soak penetration. Shows what penetration is worth. Not a real mob.
mnsdummy.preset.mirror.desc: Copies your own stats onto the dummy, offence included. Fight yourself.
mnsdummy.breakdown.empty: Hit the dummy to start a test.
mnsdummy.button.affixes.desc: Mine and Slash's own mob affixes, applied to the dummy the way the game applies them to an elite. Most only change what a mob deals, so they change nothing here; the ones that add resistance do.
mnsdummy.affix.none: Mine and Slash's affix list has not loaded.
mnsdummy.button.attack_me.desc: Have the dummy land one Mine and Slash basic attack on you. The damage is whatever MnS gives a mob of this level and rarity, put through your own armour, resists and reduction - so the ladder below is your defences doing the work, rung by rung.
mnsdummy.button.auto_attack.desc: Keep swinging on an interval, so damage taken per second can be measured the way DPS is. Switches itself off when you walk away.
mnsdummy.button.attack_element.desc: Which element the return hit is dealt as. Default is whatever Mine and Slash picks for a basic attack, which is physical before any conversion the dummy's own stats apply.
mnsdummy.defense.empty: Press Attack Me and the dummy will hit back.
mnsdummy.defense.would_have_killed: you had %s to absorb it - this would have killed you
mnsdummy.defense.survived: you had %s to absorb it - the hit took %s%% of that
mnsdummy.button.movement.desc: How much of the game may move the dummy. §eAnchored§r is the default and is what every measurement assumes: pulls, knockbacks and pushes all land and are counted, but the dummy does not budge. §ePulls Only§r lets the skills that reposition a mob outright put it somewhere else - Pull, Black Hole, Vortex Skewer, Winter's Grasp and the rest - and it is rigid again the instant it lands; knockback resistance, gravity and collision stay exactly as they are when anchored. §eFree§r drops all of it and lets the dummy be knocked about like any other mob, sword swings included.
